mapper.select: SELECT al.approval_line_id AS lineId, al.user_id AS approverId, e.name AS approverName, jp.name AS jobPositionName, d.name AS departmentName, p.name AS parentDepartmentName, al.sequence_no AS sequenceNo, al.status AS status, al.opinion AS opinion, al.processed_at AS processedAt FROM approval_line al JOIN employee e ON e.user_id = al.user_id LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN department p ON p.department_id = d.parent_id LEFT JOIN job_position jp ON jp.job_position_id = e.job_position_id WHERE al.approval_revision_id = #{revisionId} AND al.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY al.sequence_no
